name: Review Sentiment API
description: Analyze restaurant reviews across Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, DoorDash, and Uber Eats into a structured report: sentiment_score, review_velocity, complaint and praise themes, urgent_issues, fake_review_risk, recommended_responses, and reputation_score. Includes a cheap /monitor-review-risk endpoint for recurring reputation polling.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Get a full structured reputation report for a restaurant in one call.
Poll review risk cheaply every day and alert when a critical issue or fake-review spike appears.
Identify the root drivers dragging down a restaurant's star rating.
Draft empathetic responses to recent negative reviews.

agentUseCases.workflow: Run /monitor-review-risk daily; escalate to /analyze-review-sentiment when reputation_score drops or fake_review_risk rises.
Pull complaint_themes to brief content and promotions that counter the top objection.
Use negative_drivers to fix the #1 operational issue, then re-measure in 30 days.

human_approval_required._note: Endpoints are read/analysis only and generate response DRAFTS, never posting to platforms; no execution gate required. Posting a response would be a separate gated action.

chain_to.reason: Fold review findings into a quantified growth analysis.
Use urgent_issues as a high-conviction outreach hook.
Feed reputation_score into the consulting health score.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Generate response drafts for negative reviews.

examplePrompts: What are people complaining about most for this restaurant across Google and Yelp?
Is this restaurant at risk of fake reviews right now?
Draft empathetic replies to the last 10 negative reviews.
Give me the reputation score and urgent issues for Trattoria Sole.
